_: ミニゲーム島. Two houses, one per game, and that is the whole island: walk into the one whose name is over the door. Nothing here is the room's business — no coins, no positions judged — so there is no server module that reads this file; the page builds the island from it and the door opens a guest game in a frame (see client/dist/arcade.js). Coordinates are relative to the island's own x/z, exactly like every other island's JSON. Colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers.
